sources.snippet: This repository implements parameter-efficient fine-tuning (QLoRA) of OLMo-7B for conditional molecular generation using Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG). The model learns to generate molecular SMILES conditioned on molecular properties while retaining unconditional generation capability through random conditioning dropout.
